description:
## Outcome

A Scoop manifest installs the signed Windows x86-64 ZIP, exposes `jido`, verifies the release checksum, and upgrades without deleting user state.

## Work

1. Add version, architecture, immutable URL, hash, executable mapping, and update fields.
2. Use the signed GitHub release ZIP and final SHA-256 checksum.
3. Keep service registration an explicit separate action.
4. Test install, version, help, upgrade, uninstall, and state preservation.
5. Add controlled manifest-update automation after a successful stable release.
6. Document foreground daemon and optional service behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Scoop installs and runs `jido --version` without system OTP.
- [ ] A wrong hash blocks installation.
- [ ] Upgrade replaces program files and preserves the user state root.
- [ ] Install does not register or start a service.
- [ ] The manifest update uses immutable release data.
- [ ] Uninstall behavior for durable state is explicit.

## Tests

Run native Windows Scoop install, upgrade, bad-hash, path, Unicode-profile, and uninstall tests.

## Non-goals

Do not add Winget or MSI support in this task.
title: Publish a Scoop manifest for the signed Windows ZIP
